title: bug: Missing thought_signature in functionCall for Gemini 3/3.1 reasoning models

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear, actionable bug report detailing a 400 Bad Request error when using Gemini 3/3.1 reasoning models with function calling, including the exact error message, root cause, and specific functions involved.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The required fix is localized to modifying how synthetic thought signatures are assigned and scrubbed inside functionCall objects within geminiChat.ts and historyHardening.ts.

summary.problem: Gemini 3/3.1 reasoning models throw a 400 Bad Request (INVALID_ARGUMENT) error ('Function call is missing a thought_signature in functionCall parts.') when using function calling.
summary.root_cause: The synthetic thought signature is currently added only at the root of the part object (part.thoughtSignature), but the Gemini API for 3/3.1 reasoning models requires thought_signature to be nested inside the part.functionCall object. Additionally, scrubPart strips non-standard properties on functionCall.
summary.context: Adding synthetic thought signatures to both the top-level part and nested within functionCall (using both thought_signature and thoughtSignature for camelCase/snake_case compatibility), and preserving them during history scrubbing, satisfies the API validation requirements.

steps: Update ensureActiveLoopHasThoughtSignatures in packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts to populate thought_signature and thoughtSignature inside part.functionCall when attaching synthetic thought signatures.

Update pairToolsAndEnforceSignatures in packages/core/src/utils/historyHardening.ts to populate thought_signature and thoughtSignature inside part.functionCall when attaching synthetic thought signatures.
Update scrubPart in packages/core/src/utils/historyHardening.ts to preserve thought_signature and thoughtSignature on the functionCall object during scrubbing.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Function calls in active loop model turns have thought_signature and thoughtSignature populated on the nested functionCall object, surviving history scrubbing and preventing API validation failures on Gemini 3/3.1.
verification_steps: Run Vitest test suite on packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.test.ts to verify ensureActiveLoopHasThoughtSignatures attaches thought_signature and thoughtSignature to functionCall.
Run Vitest test suite on packages/core/src/utils/historyHardening.test.ts to verify hardenHistory and scrubPart preserve thought_signature on functionCall.
